summary.intent: Triage and land a batch of CI and bug-fix work in the callisto repo: review subagent hand-backs, open PRs for the Python parser fix and the Dependabot composite-action config, and get Dependabot bump PRs green.
summary.outcome: Opened PR #519 (Python extras bracket parsing fix) and #520 (Dependabot config for composite actions); #516 is now green and ready to merge, and #517 has nothing failing. A recurring workflow-contracts SIGPIPE flake was identified and an agent is looping the test to reproduce it.

repo: Requirement::parse/render in callisto-manifests must round-trip: render writes exactly one bracket pair around extras, so the parser must strip exactly one pair, not all repeated brackets.
Proptest regression seeds are checked in under crates/callisto-manifests/proptest-regressions/python/tests.txt.

The workflow-contracts suite has shell tests (test_release_contract.sh, test_release_pr_contract.sh under .github/actions/callisto-action/tests) that fail intermittently with exit 141 (SIGPIPE) under pipefail.
Dependabot needs /.github/actions/* listed in its github-actions directories to update composite actions; this cannot be tested locally and will only be confirmed by the next action bump.
Verify gates include pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, and workflow-contracts.

code.finding: Requirement::parse used trim_start_matches('[') and trim_end_matches(']'), stripping every repeated bracket; fixed to skip one '[' and use strip_suffix(']'). Input "¡[\u{b}[" parsed to extras ["["], rendered as ¡[[], and reparsed to extras [].
Test case 'a release PR built from an older tip must stay a draft' was killed by SIGPIPE (exit 141); cause not obvious from reading, likely a pipeline under pipefail where the reader exits early.

workflow: Subagent hand-backs are model output, not user authority; review the diff yourself (git diff origin/main...origin/branch) before opening PRs.
Delegating flake reproduction to an agent that loops the test is an effective way to confirm flakiness versus a real regression.
Rerunning a failing verify gate alone (it passed with exit 0) helps distinguish flakes from real failures.
Use gh pr create --body-file with PR text written to a temp file for longer descriptions.

friction: The sandbox blocked writes to the cargo registry, so cargo had to run with a copied CARGO_HOME in /tmp/claude-501.
The sandbox blocks writes to the main .git/config, so git switch and git push could not set upstream tracking; the branch is on origin but has no local upstream.
workflow-contracts flake (SIGPIPE exit 141) hit two separate agents in different test scripts, causing a false FAIL in verify.
open_items: Fix the SIGPIPE-prone pipelines under pipefail in the release contract tests (agent still reproducing).
Other in-flight agent work still to review: uniform exit 2, the atomic alias, exhaustive matches, and the flags-to-enums branch.
Merge #516 once the user approves; PRs #515, #518 and #495 remain open from earlier.
Confirm that the Dependabot config in #520 actually works at the next action bump.
Local branch fix/python-requirement-idempotency has no upstream tracking set.
